english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing, judging, guessing, or understanding something incorrectly.

examples.english: I read the date wrongly and ended up waiting all morning.
examples.traditional: 我睇錯咗個日期，搞到成朝白等。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 co3 zo2 go3 jat6 kei4 gaau2 dou3 sing4 ziu1 baak6 dang2
